{{Quote|We still have our old fighter planes! And we can use the power we've developed with our Zukonium rays to blow that maverick moon right off the star map!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Oleson]]|<ref name="TMM" />}}
This '''unidentified moon''' was a small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
{{Quote|Even if those old ships will still fly, you couldn't get close enough to blast that moon. The magnetic field is impossible to penetrate.|[[Oleson]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TMM" />}}
[[File:Planetary_Pioneers.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Planetary Pioneers]] attempt to penetrate the maverick moon's strong [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]]]]
This small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was originally part of a [[Star system/Legends|system]] located near the [[Unidentified planet (New Academy for Space Pilots)|planet]] housing the [[New Academy for Space Pilots]]. However, for unknown reasons, the moon had been blasted out of its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and was on a collision course with the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. At this point, the maverick moon was traveling at well beyond [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] and was surrounded by a strong [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]].<ref name="TMM" />

During that time, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] attended the academy as a member of the [[Planetary Pioneers]]. Having no time to evacuate the planet, Skywalker and the Planetary Pioneers boarded their old [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] in an attempt to destroy the maverick moon with [[Zukonium ray]]s.<ref name="TMM" />

Using the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Skywalker was the only [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] able to penetrate the moon's strong magnetic field. He then fired the Zukonium rays at the center of the moon and successfully destroyed it. Skywalker's X-wing was damaged by the explosion, which forced him to make an emergency landing. After his return to the academy, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] awarded Skywalker a [[medal of honor]] for saving the planet.<ref name="TMM" />
